messages:
claire-recruiter: Quick flag 19: after today's bulk candidate import some interviews show wrong interviewer (e.g., Sophie listed in CSV, but Malik appears in ATS). Not all rows affected. Anyone seen this?

nate-peopleops: We got a couple of tickets. What importer did you run?

claire-recruiter: Ran tools/ats_bulk_import.py on prod with a Greenhouse CSV: candidate_id, role, interviewer_email, slot. Sample row: `12345, Backend Engineer, sophie@redwood.ai, 2026-04-02T14:00Z` but ATS mapped to malik@redwood.ai.

lucy-ics: How many mismatches?

claire-recruiter: About 12 out of ~1700. Import validator flagged ambiguous user lookups.

evan-ild-bot: Validator: mismatch_rate=0.7% (12/1700). Reason: ambiguous email alias mapping; user_map_lookup returned multiple candidates for some email aliases (user_lookup_ambig_77).

ryan-hiring-mgr: We recently hired two Sophies (Chen and Li). CSV used sophie@redwood.ai which should map to Sophie Chen. Why Malik?

nate-peopleops: The importer has a fallback heuristic: if strict email lookup fails, use last_name+team. Malik had a legacy alias 's.chen@' in AD and Sophie Chen had a stale team tag 'infra' which confused the heuristic.

claire-recruiter: All rows had emails; I only lowercased them. No display-name rows.

ops-bot: Suggested mitigation: 1) Pause scheduled imports, 2) Re-run yesterday's import with strict email-only mapping, 3) Surface ambiguous rows to a manual review queue, 4) Notify affected interviewers/candidates.

nate-peopleops: I'll patch importer to fail on ambiguous email and add a --dry-run preflight. Will also write KB note for recruiters. ETA for hotfix branch `hotfix/import-strict-email`: 2 hours.

lucy-ics: Pausing remaining jobs now. Claire, DM the affected candidate IDs and I'll coordinate calendar fixes.

claire-recruiter: Sent DM. Also requesting a small preflight that verifies every interviewer_email uniquely maps to a user before allowing an import.

nate-peopleops: Agreed. Adding validation and a CSV of ambiguous entries in error output.

evan-ild-bot: Tests added for alias collisions.

ryan-hiring-mgr: Please post back when calendars are corrected so I can update candidates.

ops-bot: Incident note: mitigation in progress; reopen if mismatches persist after reimport. :white_check_mark:
